name: Conception
overview: Scripture reveals that conception is a divine blessing and a fulfillment of God's command to be fruitful and multiply, as seen in Genesis 1:28. The miraculous nature of conception is highlighted through the stories of Sarah, Rebekah, and Rachel, where God intervenes to open barren wombs and grant offspring at His appointed time (Genesis 21:1-2; 25:21; 30:22). This theme underscores God's sovereign power over life and His faithfulness in answering prayer, assuring His people of His providential care and timing.
